markers.reading: The party wakes after sleeping following last night’s egg encounter; neither the sleep nor the empowered state has a known duration.

evidence.quote: And so, for each of you, after having this vision, and this experience, you sleep. You sleep.
you now… wake up from, rest of… Who knows how long?

relative.anchor: Sleep ends at the waking scene dated by t03.

time.basis: Narrated sleep after last night; the subsequent morning is established, but elapsed hours are explicitly unknown.

markers.note: The prior-night egg encounter is recalled, not replayed; the narrated sleep reaches the next morning. No eight-hour rest is asserted.

markers.reading: Zeno sits up after a few minutes listening to the music in his head during the waking scene.

evidence.quote: And he sits up after a few minutes.

markers.reading: The waking scene is clarified from sunrise to about 9–10 in the morning; Grandpa Jim later calls it about 10.

evidence.quote: And as the sun begins to rise
We… it's morning, we woke up.
It's more like 9, 10 in the morning. It's like, the sun's been up for a few hours.
No, just, it's like 10 in the morning

start.basis: DM’s later clarification of the waking scene.

end.basis: Upper end of the DM’s approximate waking time, confirmed by Grandpa Jim.

markers.note: The explicit later clarification replaces the sunrise estimate. Ten lies on the morning/midday watch boundary; the interval remains approximate.

markers.reading: The food machine’s chaotic projectile output continues and then stops after a couple of minutes.

evidence.quote: But this goes on for, like, a couple minutes.
And it stops after, like, a couple minutes

duration.basis: DM explicitly narrates the duration and cessation of the output.

markers.reading: The group spends time collecting sticks and assembling food samples before leaving for Oru’s tent.

evidence.quote: You can spend a few minutes and collect some sticks.
You spend you spend the next like
after quite some time, you sort out, get all the stuff

duration.text: a few minutes, ultimately described as quite some time
duration.basis: The proposed collection interval is enacted, then its elapsed extent remains imprecise.

markers.reading: Zeno takes a little nap in the heart chamber and starts to wake as the Wanderer begins to stir.

evidence.quote: Zeno starts to take a little nap.
I think Zeno's starting to wake up.

markers.note: No rest category or exact duration is awarded.

markers.reading: Little Tony places his seated thoughts about Glenda roughly ten minutes after her arrival during the guardian encounter.

evidence.quote: it's been, like, 10 minutes since Glenda, my seagull familiar, got here

duration.basis: Little Tony’s retrospective approximate elapsed-time statement.

relative.anchor: Glenda’s arrival beside Little Tony during the guardian encounter.

time.basis: Current chair scene dated relative to Glenda’s earlier arrival.

markers.note: This spans combat and the subsequent descent; it is not ten additional minutes after sitting down.

markers.reading: Sculpit daydreams for a few minutes while sitting in the heart chamber.

evidence.quote: kinda daydreams for a few minutes
the rest of you are, you know, you're lost in your thoughts, kind of sleeping

relations.note: The DM resumes at u2363–u2371 while the others are sleeping or lost in thought; do not sum the parallel seated activities.

yamlCheck.dateAnchor: No in-world date is spoken; drStart and drEnd are null. The real-world recording date supplies no campaign date.
yamlCheck.explanation: The opening narrates sleep from the prior night to the waking morning, but its duration and the precise opening boundary remain uncertain. Subsequent played activity has a morning anchor and short advances; the final cutaway has no independent clock. Historical memories, reports of last night, and postgame speculation do not extend the elapsed session span.

boundaryUncertainties.reading: The opening includes sleeping before waking, while the egg encounter itself is recalled from the previous session.

alternatives.reading: Include the narrated sleep on the preceding night and its transition to the waking day.
Treat the prior-night sleep as opening context and date active waking play to the following morning.
